title: Bud Necrosis Disease on Mungbean & Blackgram

Header: Bud Necrosis Disease on Mungbean & Blackgram
Groundnut Bud Necrosis Virus; Vector - Thrips ( Thrips palmi ) In Sinhala Ankura Angamaraya; In Tamil Arumpu Iraththal

Prevention: Mungbean and blackgram at the onset of the rains)
Severity decreased with high plant density
Grow fast growing cereal as barrier crops against the vector (Maize or sorghum)
Remove alternate hosts like wild legumes, other solanaceous plants and weeds
Do seed treatments to delay the infections at early stages (refer yellow direct control)
Monitoring: Make regular field visits to observe diseased plants, particularly in dry season
Observe yellowing, mottling, stunting and bud necrosis
Monitor thrips population with blue sticky traps
Direct Control: Use neem seed kernel extract (30-50 g per litre of water) against vectors
Remove and burn infested plants from the field
Restrictions: The followings may be considered for seed treatment:
Treat seeds one day before sowing.
II Very toxic to aquatic animals.
